notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The Forest Lookouts page gives a county heading only, with no history text. Beyond the FFLA row, the only source is a tDAR citation record (the report itself is not held there and was not read), so the link between the 1998 report and the lookout is by catalogue keyword only. Agency left unset: the Stanislaus NF link comes from the report title, not from a statement about who runs the site. Built date, type detail, staffing, and fate are all unknown. Possible next leads: the Stanislaus NF heritage records for the Hungry burn project (report #05-16-2133) and local newspaper archives for Tuolumne County.
